name: io.github.HarimxChoi/google-surf-mcp
description: Web, academic and code search with graph RAG, data lineage, ontology and cross-project schema links.

environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_API
environmentVariables.description: SearchApi API key. Required only for SearchApi primary or fallback modes.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_SEARCH_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Provider for search and search_parallel: browser, searchapi, or fallback. Defaults to browser.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_SCHOLAR_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Provider for scholar_search: browser, searchapi, or fallback. Defaults to browser.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_BROWSER_ENGINE
environmentVariables.description: Browser engine: auto, native, or playwright. Auto uses one hidden native Chrome broker shared across local MCP sessions.

environmentVariables.name: CHROME_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the Chrome binary. Auto-detected on Windows/macOS/Linux when omitted.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_PROFILE_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the warm Chrome profile. Defaults to ~/.google-surf-mcp.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_RESEARCH
environmentVariables.description: Enable local project memory and hybrid retrieval. Defaults to true.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_RETRIEVAL_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Shared route for search and search_parallel: live or hybrid. Defaults to hybrid.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_RESEARCH_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Embedded SurrealDB data directory. Defaults to <profile>/research.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_RESEARCH_VECTOR_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Local model for HNSW retrieval and shared reranking. Defaults to Xenova/multilingual-e5-small; use off to disable.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_RESEARCH_VECTOR_LOW_MEMORY
environmentVariables.description: Disable ONNX CPU memory arena and memory pattern. Defaults to true.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_RESEARCH_VECTOR_THREADS
environmentVariables.description: ONNX intra-op thread count from 1 to 16. Defaults to 4.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_RESEARCH_REPO_AUTO
environmentVariables.description: Sparse-index at most one eligible small GitHub repository per search call. Defaults to true.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_RESEARCH_REPO_AUTO_MAX_MB
environmentVariables.description: Maximum searchable repository source-text size in MB. Assets are excluded. Defaults to 20.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_RESEARCH_REPO_AUTO_MAX_FILES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum repository source file count for automatic indexing. Defaults to 2000.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_RESEARCH_BROKER_IDLE_MS
environmentVariables.description: Shared research broker idle lifetime in milliseconds. Defaults to 60000.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_RESEARCH_READ_CONCURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Maximum concurrent research broker reads. Defaults to 4.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_RESEARCH_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Embedded SurrealDB query timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional token that raises GitHub API limits for repository inspection.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_LOCALE
environmentVariables.description: Browser locale, e.g. en-US.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_TZ
environmentVariables.description: IANA timezone, e.g. America/New_York. Defaults to system timezone.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_HEADLESS
environmentVariables.description: Controls Playwright extraction, compatibility, and recovery paths. Native search hides normal system Chrome and shows it only for CAPTCHA recovery.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_IDLE_CLOSE_MS
environmentVariables.description: Idle ms before closing the sequential ctx and pool. 0 disables idle auto-close. Defaults to 30000.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_ALLOW_PRIVATE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to allow extract on private/loopback addresses (localhost, 10.x, 192.168.x, 169.254.x, etc). Default blocks them as an SSRF guard.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_LLM_HEAL
environmentVariables.description: Enable the optional workflow-only LLM selector repair path. Defaults to false.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_LLM_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: LLM selector repair provider: anthropic or orcarouter. Defaults to anthropic.

environmentVariables.name: SURF_LLM_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Optional model override. OrcaRouter defaults to orcarouter/auto.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Anthropic API key for optional LLM-assisted selector repair.

environmentVariables.name: ORCAROUTER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OrcaRouter API key for optional LLM-assisted selector repair.
